forecast_journals.note: This app instantiates CreateBook(Personal) forecast_income / forecast_spend. ApplyEvent marks JournalEntry.kind from the rule-id prefix. A future-dated spend_cash is still an actual and is refused here. scheduled_* is the calendar-bills sibling. Payroll and envelope kinds are not invented.

bank_oauth.note: Live bank or custodian OAuth (Plaid, MX, TrueLayer, or similar) is leftover on #163. This scaffold accepts a normalized predicted movement or a predicted ending balance, not a provider SDK.

grant_path.note: first-party Connect apps call ConnectApiUrl with a verified Connect access token (authorization_code or client_credentials against WorkOS Connect). Membership still required. A Connect token never takes RATIO_DEMO_OPEN and never matches org:{id}. leftover #22: WorkOS dashboard registration, DEMO_MEMBERS naming a live WorkOS sub, unused Cognito CloudFormation resources.
